extra.description: Release: llm-anthropic 0.26 Includes new features enabled by LLM 0.32 : New models: claude-fable-5 , claude-sonnet-5 , and claude-opus-5 . #75 , #76 Added server-side tools for WebSearch , WebFetch , CodeExecution , and AnthropicMCP , available through LLM's -T interface or Python tools= . The previous -o web_search* options have been removed in favor of -T WebSearch . #79 Upgraded to llm =0.32 . Reasoning, tool calls, tool results, and server-side tool results now stream as typed events. Reason
